routes.measurement: I effective-coefficient inversion; alpha needs normalization or external restriction
routes.rank: For rho!=1, alpha and two augmentation scales have rank at most 2. Exact alpha-scale invariance persists across dates and US regimes. At rho=1 alpha is matched input revenue share but only composite augmentation identified.

routes.name: stable relative technology
routes.rank: Nonzero independent input-ratio variation; constant theta and A_X/A_L

routes.measurement: I; unrestricted time-varying augmentations leave rho unidentified

routes.rank: Two effective scales, conditional alpha/rho; constancy across observations testable.

routes.inversion: xi=[Delta log w_H-rho Delta log(Y/X)]/[(1-rho)log G]; nu=[Delta log w_L-rho Delta log(Y/L)]/[(1-rho)log G]
routes.measurement: I after elimination; no observed N, alpha, augmentation level or theta level in growth formula
routes.conditional: rho fixed; constant theta; adjacent u dates; G!=1; rho!=1
routes.rank: For joint rho/xi/nu need rank 3 stacked growth regressors. Relative wages alone only xi-nu. At rho=1 only alpha*xi+(1-alpha)*nu.

routes.measurement: I specification tests; imposed zeros are not measurements

numerical_verification.method: Independent Python scalar evaluation of the source CES, factor-price, knowledge and capitalization equations; not a Julia equilibrium solve and not empirical data

critical_cashflow_warning: AHP FCF may map F=D-I=Y-e. It cannot be inserted as D to infer I; Y,e,F then supply an accounting duplicate.
code_scope_warning: Current Julia uses CES in both countries; current manuscript theorem permits generic RoW technology. Julia line 68 says substitutes incorrectly; rho>1 means complements. No edits made.
numeraire_warning: Same-date valuation ratios may use matched nominal values, but CES levels and absolute wage/output growth require consistent real final-good units. Common inflation otherwise mimics common augmentation growth in xi and nu.
